scripts.db:reset: docker-compose -f docker-compose.postgres.yml down -v && docker-compose -f docker-compose.postgres.yml up -d
scripts.setup:db: pnpm run db:start && sleep 10 && pnpm --filter auth-service run db:create
scripts.setup:full: pnpm install && pnpm run setup:db && pnpm run build && pnpm --filter auth-service run seed:roles && pnpm --filter auth-service run seed:institucional
